title: Uniform amplitude of proper direct image on classical finite-coefficient complexes
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with the discrete topology and $f:X\to Y$ a proper morphism of schemes. Suppose $e\in\mathbf N$ bounds the Krull dimension of every fibre after every base change [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-pc-base-change] [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. For $T=X,Y$ let $\mathcal A_T=\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},A_T)$ and $D_T=D(\mathcal A_T)$ be the ordinary constant-$A$ module-sheaf categories and their unbounded derived categories, in a common universe in which the sites and all indexing families under consideration are small [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Write $G=Rf_{\mathrm{pro\acute et},*}$ for total K-injective direct image and use the classical-cohomology predicate of [sk-def-pe-classical-definition].
Then $G$ is triangulated, commutes with integer shifts, and preserves countable products with their canonical projections. For every integer $a$ and every $L\in D_X$, $L\in D_X^{\ge a}$ implies $G L\in D_Y^{\ge a}$. For every integer $b$ and every classical-cohomology $L\in D_X$, $L\in D_X^{\le b}$ implies $G L\in D_Y^{\le b+2e}$, even when $L$ is unbounded below. On the small étale sites with constant $A$ coefficients, $R^qf_{\mathrm{\acute et},*}F=0$ for every $A$-module sheaf $F$ and $q>2e$, with higher direct images as in [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. The degree inequalities refer to the standard t-structures [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. No quasi-compactness of $Y$ or bound on the cohomological dimension of a ground field is required. Moreover, the total étale direct image $E=Rf_{\mathrm{\acute et},*}:D(X_{\mathrm{\acute et}},A)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{\acute et}},A)$ preserves every small ambient coproduct, with the canonical comparison whose components are $E$ of the coprojections [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].
